name: 块效应网格分析
description: 分析 JPEG block boundary 伪影 以检测 inconsistent compression grids 表明 篡改.
algorithm: Block Artifact Grid (BAG) Extraction and Consistency Analysis
mechanism: JPEG压缩 creates an 8×8 block grid. When a region is spliced from a differently compressed source, the block grid alignment becomes inconsistent.
parameters: 块大小: 8×8, Grid 检测: cross-boundary 梯度, Alignment: phase 分析, Map: block visibility
source: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R. (2003) — Identification of Bitmap Compression History, IEEE TIP
useCase: Detecting spliced regions by finding JPEG压缩 grid 不一致

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R. (2003) — Identification of Bitmap Compression History, IEEE TIP

strengths:
• Directly linked to JPEG压缩
• Can localize tampered regions
• Well-understood theoretical basis
• Effective on single-compressed images
limitations:
• 仅适用于JPEG图像
• Double compression can mask 伪影
• Requires sufficient image quality
• May miss small tampered regions
